stories.title: Ary Fontoura desmente notícia falsa sobre sua morte: 'Estou vivo e muito bem'

en.title: Ary Fontoura denies false news about his death: 'I am alive and well'
en.summary: The 93-year-old Brazilian actor used social media to refute misinformation about his death, stating he is in good health. He criticized the misuse of his image to drive traffic to a sales webpage.

stories.title: Ladrão é preso no forro da casa da mãe após fingir que compraria R$ 10 de linguiça e roubar mercado

en.title: Thief arrested in house ceiling after pretending to buy R$ 10 of sausage and robbing grocery store
en.summary: A 24-year-old man was arrested after robbing a small grocery store by feigning a sausage purchase and simulating being armed. He was found hiding in the ceiling of his mother's house.

stories.title: Wagner Moura e Kristen Stewart trabalharão juntos mais uma vez em filme de Olivier Assayas

en.title: Wagner Moura and Kristen Stewart will work together once more in a film by Olivier Assayas
en.summary: Brazilian actor Wagner Moura and American actress Kristen Stewart will reunite for another collaboration in a film directed by Olivier Assayas.

stories.title: Ônibus bate em muro de escola e atinge veículos no Jabaquara, Zona Sul de SP

en.title: Bus hits school wall and strikes vehicles in Jabaquara, South Zone of SP
en.summary: A bus collided with a school wall and other vehicles in the Jabaquara neighborhood of São Paulo on Monday afternoon. A 42-year-old woman was injured and received emergency care.

stories.title: Janja usa medalha de Nossa Senhora Aparecida após fake news sobre padroeira

en.title: Janja wears Our Lady of Aparecida medal after fake news about patron saint
en.summary: Janja wore a medal of Our Lady of Aparecida in response to misinformation circulating about Brazil's patron saint.

stories.title: Como o despejo de uma idosa de 87 anos gerou onda de protestos por moradia na Espanha

en.title: Eviction of 87-year-old woman sparks housing protests wave in Spain
en.summary: The eviction of an elderly woman in Spain triggered widespread demonstrations demanding action on housing issues.

stories.title: Kristen Stewart e Wagner Moura estrelam novo longa dirigido por Olivier Assayas

en.title: Kristen Stewart and Wagner Moura star in new film directed by Olivier Assayas
en.summary: Director Olivier Assayas announced a new film titled "Spiritual World" featuring Wagner Moura, Kristen Stewart, and other actors in the cast.

stories.title: França sofre sem Mbappé, mas bate a Bélgica pela Liga das Nações; Itália goleia Turquia

en.title: France struggles without Mbappé but beats Belgium in Nations League; Italy routs Turkey
en.summary: France defeated Belgium in a Nations League match despite playing without Mbappé, while Italy won decisively against Turkey in the same competition.

stories.title: Flávio recorre a Fux para derrubar post sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Flávio appeals to Fux to overturn post about Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: The campaign of presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro requested that Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux suspend a decision allowing publications about Nossa Senhora Aparecida online. The campaign seeks to have the case sent to the full court based on electoral justice powers.

stories.title: Ônibus desgovernado atinge carros e bate em muro de escola em SP

en.title: Runaway bus hits cars and crashes into school wall in São Paulo
en.summary: A bus struck at least six vehicles and impacted the wall of a school in southern São Paulo during the late afternoon.

stories.title: Idosa cujo despejo inspirou protestos em Madri poderá voltar para casa

en.title: Elderly woman whose eviction inspired Madrid protests may return home
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, an elderly Madrid resident whose eviction sparked widespread protests in Spain, reached an agreement with property owners to return to her home.

stories.title: França vence Bélgica (1-0) na Liga das Nações com golaço de Olise

en.title: France defeats Belgium 1-0 in Nations League with Olise's goal
en.summary: Michael Olise scored a spectacular goal in the final minutes to give France a 1-0 victory over Belgium in the second round of the UEFA Nations League.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual em Minas Gerais (MG): veja número e nome na lista de 2026

en.title: Candidates for state representative in Minas Gerais (MG): see number and name in 2026 list
en.summary: Minas Gerais has 998 registered candidates competing for 77 state representative positions in the 2026 elections, with voting scheduled for October 4. The state has 16.377.659 eligible voters.

stories.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual em São Paulo (SP): veja número e nome na lista de 2026

en.title: Candidates for state representative in São Paulo (SP): see number and name in 2026 list
en.summary: São Paulo has 1.431 registered candidates competing for 94 state representative positions in the 2026 elections, with voting scheduled for October 4. The state has 34.104.226 eligible voters.

stories.title: CNJ determina devolução ao Tesouro de mais R$ 2,36 bi em precatórios irregulares

en.title: CNJ orders return to Treasury of additional R$ 2.36 billion in irregular court orders
en.summary: Brazil's top judicial authority ordered the cancellation of 14 court orders from sugar-alcohol plants and the return of R$ 2.36 billion to the National Treasury. This provisional measure follows a previous decision involving R$ 4.73 billion.

stories.title: Manufatura acelera modernização e demanda novas competências

en.title: Manufacturing accelerates modernization and demands new skills
en.summary: The manufacturing industry is intensifying adoption of automation, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies, requiring companies to retrain their workforce. Around 93% of manufacturers expect these transformations to significantly impact their labor force.

stories.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro atuam por desistências de candidaturas e convergência da direita

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies work toward candidate withdrawals and right-wing convergence
en.summary: Strategists for Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign are seeking to consolidate right-wing support by encouraging candidates to withdraw and unite behind him, aiming to attract voters from competing conservative candidates and reduce fragmentation in Senate and state races.
